root_cause: Dedicated image-only generation is isolated correctly, but generated image binaries are not durably and deterministically routed across task boundaries to the review-and-GitHub-persistence step. The review context can see only a subset of generated outputs, and the available GitHub text-content mutations cannot persist an already-materialized binary without a supported exact-binary handoff.

smallest_permanent_hardening.requirement: Introduce a qualification image artifact handoff contract in which every dedicated image-only worker returns a durable exact-binary artifact reference plus candidate_id/story_id lineage to a separate reviewer. The reviewer must be able to materialize the exact bytes, compute SHA-256 and dimensions, perform visual gates, and persist those exact bytes without re-encoding.
must_not_do: pass image data through lossy text encoding
edit a failed image into compliance
accept an image without exact persisted bytes
regression_acceptance: six independently generated story images produce six durable artifact references
reviewer can materialize all six exact binaries
reviewer records unique SHA-256 and dimensions for all six
accepted images persist byte-for-byte on the qualification branch
a missing or mismatched artifact fails closed

test_correction_on: fresh Q11 only after protected hardening merge
